question: Under AEMO's pre-dispatch procedure, how often is pre-dispatch run, and at what time of day does the published schedule get extended to cover the whole of the next trading day?

synthesis:draft.headline: AEMO runs pre-dispatch at half-hourly intervals, and once next‑day bid changes close AEMO publishes the pre-dispatch schedule to cover the whole of the next trading day.

document_statements.quote: As indicated in NER 3.8.20, AEMO must prepare and publish a pre-dispatch schedule in accordance with the spot market operations timetable.

document_statements.paraphrase: AEMO currently runs pre-dispatch on every half hour (i.e. on the half hour) producing schedules for each 30-minute period up to and including the last 30-minute period of the last trading day for which dispatch bid and market ancillary service bid band prices have closed.

document_statements.quote: As changes to dispatch bid and market ancillary service bid band prices for the next trading day close at 1230 hours EST, at that time AEMO publishes pre-dispatch for all 30-minute periods up to the end of the next trading day.
